title: Ankhorage Grid View
summary: Platform-neutral geometry for grid viewports, axes, snapping, selection, layout, and virtualization.
purpose: Provide deterministic grid interaction and visibility calculations that UI layers can reuse across web and native renderers.
responsibilities: Convert between viewport and world coordinates and constrain, pan, reveal, and zoom viewports.
Calculate axis ticks, snapping candidates, hit tests, selection, movement, and resize results.
Place lane intervals and matrix cells and select only visible grid items for virtualization.
boundaries: Does not render user-interface components or own input-event handling.
Does not store application state or choose a product-specific grid model.
Does not depend on a specific browser, native UI framework, or canvas implementation.
audience: UI and visualization packages that need reusable grid geometry.
Application developers implementing large interactive grids or timelines.
useCases: Pan or zoom a viewport around a stable world coordinate.
Snap, select, move, resize, or hit-test rectangular items.
Virtualize matrix cells and lane intervals inside visible world bounds.

architecture.role: Pure reusable library of deterministic geometry functions and portable types.
invariants: Geometry remains platform-neutral and free of renderer state.
Public operations return calculated values without owning UI lifecycle or persistence.
